description.value: This prospective study explored whether multiparametric MRI combining cortical thickness, white matter microstructure and resting-state functional MRI could differentiate early onset Alzheimer's disease from behavioural variant frontotemporal dementia.
This prospective study recruited EOAD patients, bvFTD patients and age-matched healthy controls consecutively.

spans.text: Sixty-two patients with a diagnosis of probable AD ( ) and age of onset < 65 years, 27 patients with a diagnosis of bvFTD ( ) and matched with AD cases for age at onset and disease duration, and 48 age-matched healthy controls were recruited consecutively at the Clinic of Neurology, Faculty of Medicine, University of Belgrade, Serbia.
